source_file_description: Claude-provided source/corridor candidates, operator-provided and not independently measured flow intelligence

source_registry.provider_note: Daily transit counts for ~28 chokepoints + port calls. Best free chokepoint dataset.
Bounding-box subscriptions per corridor. Terrestrial AIS, patchy offshore coverage.
Incident advisories Red Sea / Gulf / Indian Ocean. JMIC products too.
US MARAD maritime security advisories by region.
EU gas storage (AGSI+) + LNG terminals (ALSI). API key needed.
Gas physical flows at EU interconnection points (hourly). Best gas corridor signal.
Draft limits, Gatun Lake level, daily transits, booking slots.
Transits + revenue statements. Official numbers can lag/skew.

source_registry.publisher_endpoint_declared: Freightos FBX, Drewry WCI, Baltic Exchange
source_registry.provider_note: Rate spikes confirm corridor stress by route.
Sentinel-1/2 for port/queue/fire verification. Heavy processing.
Country internet outages catch cable cuts.
Flight density for airspace closures. Also EASA conflict zone bulletins + NOTAMs.

source_registry.publisher_endpoint_declared: Kpler / Vortexa / Windward / Lloyd's List Intelligence
source_registry.provider_note: Real cargo-level flows + dark fleet detection. Paid, add post-revenue.
EIA World Oil Transit Chokepoints analysis + weekly US flows.
Keyword + geo filter per corridor. Dedup + whitelist.
Geocoded events within X km of corridor line. Commercial licence.

corridors.name: Strait of Hormuz
corridors.notes: Largest oil chokepoint. Watch GPS spoofing + tanker seizures.

corridors.name: Bab el-Mandeb / Red Sea (southern)
corridors.candidate_status_note: verify - live conflict-driven rerouting since late 2023

corridors.name: Taiwan Strait
corridors.notes: Taiwan MND daily ADIZ reports are the key source - verify feed/scrape.

corridors.name: Black Sea shipping lanes + Kerch Strait
Cape of Good Hope route
corridors.notes: Its traffic is the inverse indicator of Suez/Red Sea stress.

corridors.name: Russia-to-Europe gas routes (Ukraine transit, Yamal-Europe, TurkStream, Nord Stream)
corridors.candidate_status_note: verify - Nord Stream damaged since 2022; Ukraine transit status changed, check live ENTSOG data

corridors.name: Power of Siberia 1 and 2
corridors.candidate_status_note: verify - PoS-2 deal status unclear; flows data mostly company-reported

corridors.name: Saudi East-West (Petroline) + Habshan-Fujairah (UAE)
corridors.notes: Hormuz bypass capacity. Stress here = Hormuz risk priced in.

corridors.name: China-Europe Railway Express (Northern / Central / Southern routes)
corridors.notes: No clean free API. Poland/Kazakh/Chinese customs + operator statements.

corridors.name: BRI Indochina + BCIM corridors (China-Laos rail, China-Myanmar economic corridor)
Myanmar (Kachin/Shan) -> Yunnan heavy rare earth ore flow
corridors.notes: Key heavy RE feedstock for China separation. No official Myanmar feed - triangulate via China import data + conflict + satellite.

corridors.name: China processed rare earth + magnet exports (to US/EU/JPN/KOR/IND)
US supply chain (MP Materials Mountain Pass + DoD offtake + magnet plants)
Emerging non-China RE sources (VNM, BRA, IND, GRL, KAZ, SWE, CAN, NAM, MWI, TZA)
Red Sea / Egypt subsea cable hub
Middle East airspace (Iran, Iraq, Syria, Israel, Gulf)

capability_disclaimer: Neither approximate centroid nor analyst 1-5 criticality establishes physical route geometry, flow telemetry, current disruption, risk score, licensable data or signed GRO.
